recommendations.wide_lens_note: Fisheye or multi-camera array (very wide FOV)

hardware_recommendations.explanation: Chosen because the required Horizontal FOV is {hfov}°. For FOV < 120° we use rectilinear low-distortion lenses (<0.5% distortion) for accurate measurements/OCR. If FOV > 120°, a fisheye would be needed instead.

Required resolution is {mp} MP — buy a {rec_mp} MP camera (next standard tier above your requirement). GigE global-shutter monochrome recommended for high speed, low noise, and excellent contrast. GigE interface is standard in India for easy integration with PLCs.

For {task} inspection we need uniform, high-contrast illumination. Diffuse dome eliminates glare on shiny solder/components; coaxial is best for flat PCBs. Strobing synchronises with camera trigger to freeze motion and increase brightness without heat.

hardware_recommendations.template: OpenCV + EasyOCR (for OCR) / Halcon / Cognex VisionPro / Keyence Vision
hardware_recommendations.explanation: For {task} we use a combination of classical vision (OpenCV/Halcon) for speed and AI-based tools (EasyOCR / VisionPro) for robust character recognition and anomaly detection on SMD components.
